title: Kinetix AMM V3 (Kava+Base): canonical Uniswap V3 fork; residual custody $184.3k, unprivileged extraction $0
closed_reasons: All 155 Kava + 21 Base pools sit at the canonical Uniswap V3 CREATE2 init-code-hash addresses (0xe34f199b...) -> deployed pool bytecode is provably canonical Uniswap V3 v1.0.0

Kava factory and NFPM runtime bytecode are byte-identical to canonical Uniswap deployments (factory: own-address literal only; NFPM: 3 immutables only) -> no Kinetix-specific logic in custody contracts
Source diffs: pool/factory/deployer/staker/NFPM are upstream Uniswap code with renames only
All 1,670 NFPM positions enumerated: 674/675 owners are EOAs; the only contract owner is a Gnosis Safe holding the dominant $147k position (holder-only)
All non-NFPM pool positions traced to identified third-party vaults (23 Steer, 4 ICHI, 1 Arrakis-style) plus 5 Kinetix x-vaults with <$2 residual; withdrawals are share-gated
Protocol fees ($18.05) are collectable only by the factory-owner EOA (onlyFactoryOwner) - privileged, not attacker
Fork tests: attacker collect/collectProtocol/decreaseLiquidity/collect/transferFrom/unstake all revert or no-op with balances unchanged; staker holds nothing
key_facts: Live on-chain custody today: Kava $184,266 nominal (155 pools) + Base $25.79 (21 pools) = $184,292; token amounts essentially unchanged since triage (pools lightly active, dust-level bot swaps, net balances stable)

Liquid-asset subset of Kava value ~= $97,720 (stables/WKAVA/BTC/ETH/ATOM/BIFI); ~= $86,546 is dead-token legs (WAGMI $78.6k at GeckoTerminal price whose only market is the pool itself, HOV $1.4k, KAI $6.5k)
Kava factory 0x2dBB6254231C5569B6A4313c6C1F5Fe1340b35C2 owner = EOA 0xD6F5c0737026E0E662E514eE0e08cCE6B2Bf5c4a; feeProtocol=0x44 (25% of swap fees) on pools; total accrued protocol fees $18.05
Dominant position: NFPM #511 (WAGMI/WKAVA 1% pool 0xc81Fde7F...), liquidity 15,663,710,217,888,675,764,825,981, owned by Gnosis Safe 0x7D5CEA2e5fBDFecca8CcfbFe85AC021C817a7f38, value $147,262
Staker 0x011C835aBF4BCeD2ECb51C466E157f467F6dB5AD: 0 NFTs, 0 tokens, no deposits (older 4-word deposit variant)
Kinetix USDt/WKAVA LP share-vault 0xFf05fA6e5b1B19FfdCA00392E6eAe9C696270a6D residual position value < $1; its only pool-facing function found is collect(); no deposit/withdraw resolved
Base pools all canonical; largest Base pool value $15.93 (WETH/AERO); total $25.79
Triage headline $175,793 was DefiLlama-derived (graph-frozen); on-chain token amounts are the ground truth and are unchanged
caveats: WAGMI/HOV/KAI prices are illiquid micro-cap estimates; WAGMI's only market is the very Kinetix pool that holds it (circular pricing). Liquid-asset value is ~$99.1k.
Third-party vault internals (Steer/ICHI) not audited (out of finding scope); Arrakis vault withdraw gate verified to reject non-holders; vault liveness not fully proven.
Kinetix AMM V1/V2, perps and airdrop contracts are separate findings and were not audited here.

Kava has no third-party-usable explorer API (Kavascan 403 / Routescan unsupported); deployment enumeration done via events + CREATE2 math, which is exhaustive for this factory but cannot prove no other factory exists outside the official deployment set.
Base block number in this file is approximate (recorded in ci-out/run-info.txt on each run).
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0 live from Kinetix AMM V3: the $184.3k residual (Kava $184.3k + Base $26) sits in pools provably running canonical Uniswap V3 bytecode, owned by EOA/Gnosis-Safe LP positions and share-gated third-party vaults, with only $18 of protocol fees (owner-only).
